variant_decisions.evidence: Qere אֶצָּרְךָ and ketiv אצורך are both first-person imperfect forms of יצר with a 2ms suffix, differing only in orthography (defective vs. plene waw); they carry the same sense and the same person, number, and tense. ASV 'Before I formed thee in the belly' renders that sense and no more, and JER.1.5 carries no ASV note mapped to this unit, so the English cannot distinguish the two. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
